title: Disseminating Jewish Literatures
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: The multilingualism and polyphony of Jewish literary writing around the globe requires a collaborative, comparative, and interdisciplinary investigation into the methods of researching and teaching literature. This volume presents case studies from a broad range of approaches to Jewish literatures across different languages, including Arabic, English, French, German, Hebrew, Hungarian, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, and Yiddish.
